sections.title: Describe the communities your program serves and their barriers to dental care.
sections.body_md:
Riverbend serves rural families in Chelan and Douglas counties. [c1]

The foundation funds preventive dental care in rural Washington. [c2]

Most families we serve live more than 40 miles from a dentist who accepts Medicaid.
unverified_claims: Most families we serve live more than 40 miles from a dentist who accepts Medicaid.

sections.body_md: We will track the number of children who receive sealants each year. [c3]
